question: Which of the following states rank first and second, respectively, in population, according to the Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh, and Maharashtra** rank first and second, respectively, in population, according to the Census 2011.
 
• As per the census 2011, Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India with a population of 19.98 Crores.
 
• Total population of **Maharashtra as per 2011** census is **112,374,333 of which male and female are 58,243,056 and 54,131,277 respectively.**
 
• The 15th Census of India was started on 1st April 2010 with a slogan of "Our Census Our Future".
 
• The total population of India as per the Census 2011 is 1210.19 million.
 
• The Census was first started under British Viceroy Lord Mayo in 1872.

 Census of 2021__

__
 
• It will be the 16th Census of India and the 8th Census of Independent India.
 
• The theme of Census 2021 is “Jan Bhagidari se Jan Kalyan”.
 
• Census 2021 will be completely paperless and the process of collection and classification of population data will be completely digital.
 
• A mobile app issued by the government will be used in the process of the census.
 
• Information can be given in 16 languages ​​through this app, this information will be verified by senior officials.
